name: Mayalde (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist red and the fly white with three blue horizontal stripes.
history: The full council of Mayalde, in ordinary session on 24 March 1999, unanimously approved the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2 by 3, formed of two vertical stripes, red at the hoist and white with three equal blue horizontal stripes at the fly.

features.role: three equal horizontal stripes on the white fly
